Data:Nxc.n.endeavour.corso.sabotage.json.label: Sabotage
Data:Nxc.n.endeavour.corso.sabotage.json.preface: 'I said my research would upset my friends on the Continent… it gets worse. New King's building something like a manufactured incarnate Name. Calls itself Fissifer.  Now I'm nobody's patriot, I go where I'm paid, but there's a nasty imbalance of power here, and I think if I were to help my continental friends break up Fissifer and hand bits of him round various powers, it'd advance the cause of peace. I'm serious. So, if you've got Cygnifer's thing on the dividing serpent - or just something decent on Pyroglyphics [10] - that'll help the cause of peace.'
Data:Nxc.n.endeavour.corso.sabotage.json.desc: 'Nah, can't get anything out of that. Take another look in the back?'

Data:Nxc.n.endeavour.hokobald.protect.js.label: Protect
Data:Nxc.n.endeavour.hokobald.protect.js.preface: 'The New King has sponsored the construction of a vessel for a Name of the fire that is to come. Various miscreants propose to sabotage it. Whatever your feelings on the politics of the Mansus and the Wake, Librarian, you will recognise that such a provocation might very well spark war. And I find war inconvenient. So I ask for your help in arranging protection. Something on the alchemies of the Sunset Road would be very useful. Or failing that, a competent text on Bells & Brazieries [10] might give me what I need.'
Data:Nxc.n.endeavour.hokobald.protect.js.desc: 'This is very disappointing. You must have something better.'

Data:Nxc.n.endeavour.serena.reveal.json.label: Reveal
Data:Nxc.n.endeavour.serena.reveal.json.preface: 'They are building a Name, a sort of counterfeit Ghirbi, in the royal dockyards - a vessel of the Chandler's fires. I must take action. It is a little treasonous, I grant you. I am still technically a subject of his Majesty. But I hope very much that you will help me. Do have anything by Vinzant on resonance and alchemy? It's possible my emissaries can persuade the wretched thing to shake itself to pieces... failing that, we'll have to resort to Pyroglyphics [10]'.
Data:Nxc.n.endeavour.serena.reveal.json.desc: 'Not what I needed. Don't worry, I remember it's harder than it looks. Do you have anything else?'

Hokobald is offended by the Moth's challenge to Calyptra.

'Certainly the Mansus needs shaking up, but Moth is too grubby and indignified a power to be allowed more latitude. I will shut down this business in Venice before these wretched flowers spread any further in the Wake. Bring me something on Edicts Inviolable [12]. Or better yet, if you have it, on the Madrugad's White Ceremony.'

Data:Nxc.n.invisible.failed.morgen.troub.preface:
Morgen is eager to seize this opportunity to stir up trouble among the Hours.

'Why? I always have my reasons, Librarian. But since it is you, I will say that I have been wounded by Calyptra, and also wounded by the cabal which opposes them. Will you help me? With something on Sickle & Eclipse [12]? Or if you have that battle-book of Juceh's, it will be an inspiration to wayward Names...'

Data:Nxc.n.invisible.salvaged.arun.assis.preface:
Arun - for once -  is taking sides. He hopes to challenge the predominance of the Calyptra, by distracting or even weakening the Madrugad.

''Where these flowers grow, the world grows - how can I put this? - tolerant. I am an advocate for tolerance, Librarian... and I have an idea. I think the key to this matter may be found here, at Brancrug. Do you have anything on the Winter Tower?'

Data:Nxc.n.lark.serena.assist.serena.wit.preface: 'Zidane - the silly boy - was not only using unsanctioned alloys. He had also happened on a trove of Roost-secrets. There is good reason that the aviform Hours guard the Roost so jealously. These secrets are seeds of strife and scandal - if we want to preserve the order of the Mansus it is essential that they be discreetly returned. I think I know where to find them, but arranging a safe audience with their owners will be much more challenging.  Anything on the Roost? Or on Path & Pilgrim [10]?' [One book might make Serena reconsider.]
